items.title: Lawrence Cotton Interview, 1996-12-10
items.q: We went through Texas, and we tore it up with those people... We played for T-Bone Walker, played for Joe Turner, and also played for Slim, all on the same stage.

ctx.x: But Slim with his guitar, he had a clamp. He didn't know how to play without the clamp, the choke on it. He couldn't play without it, right? And T-Bone Walker tried to get him to change his style, you know, but he didn't take the time to do it. But with his amplifier on, trying to find the key. So the trumpet player, he made a modulation for everybody to go to D-flat. That's the only thing that saved us on the stage at times. So Schiffman said, no, we can't use this for finality. That's the end of the show.…
You mentioned there was a screen. What was it? The screen?
